surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey baseline and the darker pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Prominent longitudinal fold or indentation causing internal shadow casting along the left side of the dorsal axis.
